newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm in quiet Friday trade.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm in quiet Friday trade.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds mainly firmed on Friday but dealers said the market was calm after the U.S. Thanksgiving holiday and because of the approaching year-end.
"It is Friday today, yesterday was a holiday in the U.S. Everything is quiet but some buying was seen," Avtobank dealer Ivan Kuznetsov said.

Dealers said some operators were closing their positions at the end of the financial year. Kuznetsov said "There are people thinking about next year. Russia looks attractive, it is not yet seen as expensive."
